meaning:
§ Libnah = "pavement"
a station between Sinai and Kadesh of Israel during their wilderness wanderings

elsewhere.note: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.
Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.
So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken Yahweh, the God…
So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
